Class MediaPlayer

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.client.media.MediaPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class MediaPlayer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Window-owned media playback. Decode/download work runs on daemon workers; draw/upload and close belong on the client render thread. At most three decoded frames wait in memory. Seek replaces the decoding generation so late results cannot overwrite the new position. Audio uses a Java Sound output line and is independent of Minecraft's positional sound engine and volume sliders.

      public static MediaPlayer open(MediaSource source, MediaSource.Kind kind, MediaOptions options, MediaDecoder decoder)
      Starts asynchronous preparation without automatically playing audio/video. Still frames can be drawn immediately.
      Parameters:

      kind - intended stream category
      options - bounded output settings
      decoder - installed decoder

      independent player; tie it to a window with window.ownVisual(player)

    • audioFramesPlayed

      public long audioFramesPlayed()
      Reads the number of PCM sample frames consumed by this generation's audio output line. It remains available after the line reaches EOF or closes; it does not claim that a physical speaker was audible.
      Returns:
      presented audio sample frames

    • update

      public void update()
      Advances CPU presentation and end/loop handling. Call from the client tick/render callback, including audio-only players.

    • draw

      public boolean draw(double x, double y, double width, double height, float opacity)
      Uploads changed frames and draws into the caller's existing GUI projection. It can be drawn inside an AnimatedElement.
      Parameters:
      x - GUI left
      y - GUI top
      width - drawn width
      height - drawn height
      opacity - alpha multiplier from zero to one
      Returns:
      false before a frame exists or after a fatal failure/closure

    • close

      public void close()
      Cancels workers/processes/output and deletes this player's GPU image. Call on the client render thread.
